headlines.title: 中国央行：将开展14000亿元买断式逆回购操作 期限为6个月（184天）
headlines.summary: 中国央行公告，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年7月15日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展14000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（184天），到期日为2027年1月15日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: China's central bank will conduct 1.4 trillion yuan in outright reverse repo operations with a 6-month (184-day) term.
headlines.summary_en: PBOC announces that to maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, on July 15, 2026, it will conduct a 1400 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation via fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award, with a term of 6 months (184 days) and maturity on January 15, 2027 (postponed if holiday).

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with Solomon Islands Foreign and External Trade Minister Honipvella
headlines.summary_en: CPC Central Committee Political Bureau member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing on the 14th with Solomon Islands' Minister of Foreign Affairs and External Trade, Peter Shanel Agovaka. Wang Yi stated that facts have proven that China and Solomon Islands established diplomatic relations on the right side of history. China is willing to work with the new Solomon Islands government to continuously elevate bilateral relations to new heights. China's development of relations with Pacific Island countries aims to strengthen South-South cooperation and promote common development, without geopolitical intentions or pursuit of a so-called 'sphere of influence', and should not be interfered with by third parties. Pacific Island countries have the right to independently choose their development partners. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 隆基绿能：预计上半年净亏损为34亿元到38亿元，上年同期亏损25.69亿元
headlines.summary: 报告期内，光伏行业供需关系未有显著改善，企业经营持续承压。受新能源消纳不足及去年同期抢装高基数等多重因素影响，国内上半年新增光伏装机阶段性大幅回落。报告期内，公司组件销量和收入同比下降，开工率不足，毛利率较低，叠加联营企业投资损失及人民币升值带来的汇兑损失等影响，形成经营业绩亏损。 报告期内，面对行业经营困境，公司大力推进光伏业务全面BC化，持续丰富场景产品矩阵，海外市场销量和BC产品销量占比显著提升，BC技术提效降本举措持续落地，ACM（纳米合金矩阵式接触）电池实现规模化投产。

headlines.title_en: LONGi Green Energy: Expected net loss in H1 of 3.4 to 3.8 billion yuan, compared to a loss of 2.569 billion yuan in the same period last year
headlines.summary_en: During the reporting period, the supply-demand relationship in the photovoltaic industry saw no significant improvement, and corporate operations continued to face pressure. Affected by multiple factors including insufficient new energy consumption and a high base from last year's rush installations, domestic new photovoltaic installed capacity saw a substantial phased decline in the first half of the year. During the reporting period, the company's module sales and revenue decreased year-on-year, with low capacity utilization rates and low gross margins. Combined with investment losses from associated enterprises and exchange losses from RMB appreciation, the company incurred operating losses. During the reporting period, facing industry operational difficulties, the company vigorously promoted the comprehensive BC transformation of its photovoltaic business, continuously enriched the scenario-based product matrix, and significantly increased overseas market sales and the proportion of BC product sales. BC technology efficiency improvement and cost reduction measures were continuously implemented, and ACM (Nano-alloy Matrix Contact) batteries achieved规模化 (large-scale) production.

headlines.title_en: Yangtze Optical Fibre: Expects H1 net profit to rise 711% to 914% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: Yangtze Optical Fibre announces that it expects net profit for the first half of the year to be approximately 2.400 billion yuan to 3.000 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 711% to 914%. During the reporting period, driven by accelerated construction of computing data centers, demand for new types of optical fiber and cable products continued to grow both domestically and internationally, improving industry supply-demand dynamics. The company leveraged its globally leading position, seized international market opportunities, and expanded computing data center-related businesses, achieving core customer expansion, product structure optimization, and profitability improvement, with operating results up year-on-year.

headlines.title: 两部门紧急预拨4.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持10省区市做好抢险救灾工作
headlines.summary: 财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持广西、浙江、河北、辽宁、天津、黑龙江、江苏、安徽、江西、四川等10省（区、市）开展防汛防台风应急抢险救灾工作。其中，在前期预拨1.9亿元基础上，追加预拨1.5亿元，支持广西继续重点做好受灾群众安置、过渡期生活救助以及倒损民房修复等工作，推动灾区尽快恢复正常生产生活秩序；预拨2.8亿元，支持其余9省（市）统筹做好搜救转移安置受灾人员、排危除险等应急处置、开展次生灾害隐患排查和应急整治等，最大限度减少灾害损失。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Two departments urgently allocate 430 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support flood control and disaster relief efforts in 10 provinces
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 430 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support 10 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities), including Guangxi, Zhejiang, Hebei, Liaoning, Tianjin, Heilongjiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Sichuan, in carrying out flood prevention, typhoon prevention, and emergency rescue and relief efforts. Among them, on the basis of an earlier 190 million yuan allocation, an additional 150 million yuan was allocated to support Guangxi in continuing to focus on resettling affected people, providing transitional living assistance, and repairing damaged or collapsed houses, to help the disaster area restore normal production and living order as soon as possible; 280 million yuan was allocated to support the other nine provinces (cities) in coordinating search, rescue, relocation, and resettlement of affected people, emergency response such as hazard removal and risk elimination, and conducting inspections and emergency remediation of secondary disaster risks, to minimize disaster losses. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金 支持10省（区、市）做好抢险救灾工作
headlines.summary: 财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持广西、浙江、河北、辽宁、天津、黑龙江、江苏、安徽、江西、四川等10省（区、市）开展防汛防台风应急抢险救灾工作。其中，在前期预拨1.9亿元基础上，追加预拨1.5亿元，支持广西继续重点做好受灾群众安置、过渡期生活救助以及倒损民房修复等工作，推动灾区尽快恢复正常生产生活秩序；预拨2.8亿元，支持其余9省（市）统筹做好搜救转移安置受灾人员、排危除险等应急处置、开展次生灾害隐患排查和应急整治等，最大限度减少灾害损失。（央视新闻）

headlines.title: 中汽协回应新能源车平均车龄仅1.8年：系误读，不等于换车频率
headlines.summary: 7月14日，中国汽车工业协会后市场分会发布澄清声明，称《2025中国汽车后市场年度发展报告》传统动力类型乘用车在用车平均车龄约8.2年，新能源乘用车普及时间短、近年销量高速增长、新增上牌车辆占比高，因此，整体存量新能源乘用车平均车龄约1.8年。该数值仅反映的是行业转型发展现阶段特征，与当前市场情况一致，符合客观事实和现实体感，不代表车主仅1.8年就更换车辆，也不代表车辆使用寿命平均为1.8年。

headlines.title_en: China Automobile Association responds to claim that average age of new energy vehicles is only 1.8 years: It is a misinterpretation, not equal to replacement frequency
headlines.summary_en: On July 14, the Aftermarket Branch of the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers issued a clarification statement, stating that the '2025 China Automotive Aftermarket Annual Development Report' indicates the average age of traditional fuel passenger cars in use is approximately 8.2 years. New energy passenger cars have a short penetration time, high sales growth in recent years, and a high proportion of newly registered vehicles. Therefore, the overall stock of new energy passenger cars has an average age of approximately 1.8 years. This figure only reflects the current characteristics of the industry's transformation and development stage, consistent with the current market situation and objective facts and actual experience. It does not mean that owners replace vehicles after only 1.8 years, nor does it represent an average vehicle service life of 1.8 years.
